job2cool/web_search.name: web_search
job2cool/web_search.description: Search the web and return titles, URLs and snippets. Backed by a stealth browser (Camoufox) in the isolated websearch service.

tutor/next_question.description: Advance to the next question in the current package and show it. Use when the student asks to move on, skip, or continue.
tutor/next_question.name: next_question

tutor/previous_question.description: Go back to the previous question in the current package and show it.
tutor/previous_question.name: previous_question

tutor/goto_question.description: Jump to a specific question by its 1-based number within the current package and show it.
tutor/goto_question.name: goto_question

tutor/open_package.description: Open a question package by its id (load it and show its questions). Use to switch packages.

package_id.description: The id of the package to open (e.g. ai-901-core)

tutor/open_package.name: open_package

tutor/get_current_state.description: Return what the student is currently looking at: the active package, the current question (stem, options, type), and whether they have answered it (and if it was correct). Use to ground your help in the live state.
tutor/get_current_state.name: get_current_state

tutor/get_progress.description: Return the student's progress in the current package: how many questions answered, how many correct, and the total.
tutor/get_progress.name: get_progress

tutor/web_search.description: Search the web for current or external information not covered by the package material. Returns titles, URLs and snippets to cite. Use only when the answer is outside the package content.
tutor/web_search.name: web_search

tutor/submit_answer.description: Grade the answer the student states (e.g. "I think it is B"). Pass the chosen option as a letter (A/B/C), number, id, or its text. Grading is deterministic against the package key; returns whether it was correct and which option(s) are correct.

answer.description: The chosen option: letter (A/B/C…), 1-based number, option id, or option text.

answers.description: For multiple-answer questions, the chosen options.

tutor/submit_answer.name: submit_answer

tutor/get_grounding.description: Return the verbatim source passages and citations the CURRENT question was written from (its concepts grounding). Use this to explain or cite from the source material.
tutor/get_grounding.name: get_grounding

tutor/get_mastery.description: Return the student per-concept mastery for the current package: ability (0..1), attempts, correct, and whether each concept is mastered. Requires the student to be signed in.
tutor/get_mastery.name: get_mastery

tutor/next_best_question.description: Adaptively navigate to the best next question: an unanswered question on the student weakest in-scope concept at a difficulty just above their ability. Returns the new state.
tutor/next_best_question.name: next_best_question

agent_runtime/newsapi_search.description: Search NewsAPI for recent articles matching a keyword or phrase, returning the matching articles and the total result count.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for

agent_runtime/newsapi_search.name: newsapi_search

agent_runtime/fetch_url.description: Fetch the content of a web URL. Returns the page text (HTML stripped to readable text).
agent_runtime/fetch_url.name: fetch_url
